report.executive_summary: January delivered 342 demo requests at $70 CPA—exceeding our 300 conversion goal by 14% while beating our $75 CPA target. The new landing page launched mid-month drove a significant improvement in conversion rate, particularly on mobile. Year-over-year, we're up 59% in conversions at 19% lower CPA. February focus: scaling the Product Features campaign while addressing declining remarketing efficiency.
